title: Chapter 270 Ten Years Have Passed
content:
Chapter 270 Ten Years Have Passed

The expression on his face is very worthy of a beating.

But everyone at the scene was helpless.

"Wait, my senior brother will be here soon, you're done!"

A college student in a fiery red gown pointed to the knife-holding boy on the competition platform and shouted angrily.

Someone immediately recognized it.

"It's a disciple of Huoyun Peak!"

Fire Cloud Peak.

One of the nine peaks in the inner courtyard.

The Lord of Huoyun Peak is one of the top strong men of Tiandi Academy.

He has a top-level immortal fire, killing and terrifying.

As disciples of Huoyun Peak, each of them is a master who is good at playing with fire and is extremely powerful.

Seeing this, everyone felt a little relieved.

With Huoyun Peak's disciples coming forward, this challenge should be won.

On the competition stand, the boy holding a knife smiled.

"Then you better let him come quickly, don't let me wait."

Hearing this, the disciple of Huoyun Peak clenched his fists.

At this moment, the temperature of the scene suddenly increased.

"So brave!"

The next moment, a red flame suddenly flew from afar.

boom!

With a loud bang, the competition platform vibrated.

The fire dissipated, and a handsome boy in a fiery red robe appeared in everyone's eyes.

"Senior Brother Lin!"

"It's Lin Chi!"

Lin Chi, a disciple of Huoyun Peak.

The 20th Martial Arts List, a strong man in the early stage of the Immortal Saint Realm.

When they saw Lin Chi, everyone's emotions were instantly ignited.

"Senior Lin Chi, come on!"

"Senior Lin, get him!"

The young man holding the knife looked at Lin Chi in front of him, and his mouth slightly raised, "Early stage of the Immortal Saint Realm? Is it still a little weak."

Hearing this, Lin Chi laughed furiously, "Weak?"

"Ha ha ha ha."

“It’s been a long time since no one said I’m weak.”

Wow!

A red flame burned from Lin Chi's hand, and the space on the competition platform began to buzz.

"It's my senior brother's real name, Immortal Fire!"

"Stable and stable."

As soon as he came up, Lin Chi took out his trick. Obviously, although Lin Chi despised the other party.

But I attach great importance to it in my heart.

No one knows how much pressure Lin Chi is in his heart at this moment.

The moment Lin Chi just arrived here, the young man with the sword released his breath and rushed straight towards him.

What kind of aura is that?

It was as if thousands of swords pierced into the body!

"Are you ready?"

Seeing that Lin Chi did not retreat, the young man with the sword drew his sword and pressed his shoulders, looking at Lin Chi with a smile.

"Come!"

Lin Chi shouted coldly, and then the flames wrinkled.

laugh!

With one knife, Lin Chi's flames were divided into two.

Lin Chi's pupils shrank sharply.

laugh!

With the second knife, blood splattered everywhere, and Lin Chi flew out of the competition platform.

The scene fell into silence again.

Two knifes.

The disciple of Huoyun Peak, 20th in the martial arts list, was defeated.

There was disbelief in everyone's eyes.

The sword-holding boy in front of him is so strong?

"This person's strength is at least the top in the martial arts list."

A student from the arts school stood in the audience and said with a serious expression.

When some people heard this comment, they didn't believe it, but when they saw the person who was talking, they suddenly believed it.

The man looked pretty, holding a feather fan in his hand, and was frowning at the knife-holding boy on the stage.

Xu Zijing, Wenyuan!

Although his strength is not outstanding in the inner courtyard, Xu Zijing is most famous for knowing everything.

I am given a nickname, I understand brother.

"So it's Brother Dong, I'm not respectful."

"Brother Dong, is it possible? Only seniors in the top martial arts list can deal with him?"

Someone asked without believing in evil.

Hearing this, Xu Zijing slapped the feather fan in his hand and said in a low voice: "Not."

"Haha, I know."

But before the man could be happy, Xu Zijing said again: "The first few in the Wenbang are fine."

As soon as these words came out, everyone was silent.

Although in terms of combat power, the overall strength of the martial arts list is stronger than that of the literary list.

After all, most of the Literature Academy are people who study literature, and they are cultural people, so they are naturally not good at fighting, killing and killing.

But the first few on the two lists are different.

Those who can reach the top of the list are all the best among the two hospitals.

There is basically no gap in strength.

Those who can fight in the top few martial arts list can also fight in the top few martial arts list.

At this time, the knife-holding boy on the competition stand was still shouting.

"Damn it, can you really let him despise my academy here?"

Some people said indignantly.

"What can I do? Even the 20th martial arts list cannot be beaten, and we can't do it."

"Alas, it seems that the top two lists are not in the academy, and there are a few of them who are also in seclusion."

Everyone shook their heads, with helplessness in their eyes.

When the young man holding the knife on the stage saw that there was no one, he directly stood up with his broken knife and sat cross-legged on the ground.

"The name of Tiandi Academy is indeed an exaggeration."

The boy shook his head and sighed, his face full of disappointment.

Everyone gritted their teeth again when they saw it.

at the same time.

In a deep valley of the academy.

This is the location of the fantasy secret realm of the Tiandi Academy.

Buzz —

The space suddenly trembled at the exit of the dream secret realm that had been silent for a long time.

The next moment, two figures supported each other and slowly walked out of the tunnel.

"Finally, we finally came out."

"I feel like my body is being hollowed out."

Xiao Luo and Qin Feng looked haggard, as if they had just experienced a century-old war.

He looked around.

Nothing changed basically.

The old man who was guarding the mysterious dream was still half lying there, his face covered with a straw hat, not knowing whether he was sleeping or waking up.

Qin Feng was silent for a moment, then helped Xiao Luo toward the old man.

"Ahem, senior?"

"What's the matter?"

The old man did not move, but said lightly.

Qin Feng smiled awkwardly and said, "Senior, I wonder how long has it been gone?"

The two are in the secret realm and have no idea about time.

"ten years."

The old man still said lightly.

Upon hearing this, Qin Feng and Xiao Luo were shocked.

The two looked at each other with bitterness in their eyes.

"Thank you, senior, I'll say goodbye."

Then, the two supported each other and headed far away.

"Brother Qin, it's ten years."

On the way, Xiao Luo sighed.

He never expected that it would have been ten years since he entered the secret realm.

Although this is not very exaggerated, it will take tens of thousands of years to come out of some secret realms.

It’s not a lot in just ten years.

But what the two were worried about was Lu Xue.

The two of them stayed in the secret realm for ten years, but I still don’t know how much Lu Xue has done in the past ten years.

When they were in the deserted city, they made a promise.

I will definitely do my best to assist Lu Xue.

But now.

"Ten years, ten years, with Sister Xue's talent, I'm afraid she has already become famous in the Immortal Realm at this moment."

Qin Feng was sighing on the side.

I felt a little disappointed.

"Go back quickly, maybe Sister Xue is still waiting for us."

Xiao Luo squeezed out a smile, and the two of them stopped talking and quickly accelerated their pace.

Zhuyun Peak.

A practice room.

"Huh~"

Lu Xue slowly opened her eyes, and her breath suddenly surged.

The peak of the Immortal Lord Realm!

More importantly, Lu Xue is already basically familiar with the several martial arts and martial arts in her hands.

For Lu Xue, it would be better to only practice those ice-type books.

Next, only practical training is left to integrate.
